tasks.subject: Task 2: xa_spectra.py core — line_list (no-M + M-resolved)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the module with line_list returning a tidy DataFrame (freq, strength, labels) using the thesis line-strength definition; no Boltzmann, no J_adjust.

**Files:** Create Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/xa_spectra.py + Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/test_xa_spectra.py.

**Acceptance:** no-M strength == branching_ratios entry exactly (Physics A); BaF (-)/N=0 freqs reproduce 3 Table II values <=2 MHz; empty selection -> empty DataFrame (LINE_COLUMNS) + UserWarning, no crash.

**Verify:** conda run -n Structure python "Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/test_xa_spectra.py"; echo EXIT=$?

**Steps:** write test_xa_spectra.py (Physics A + Table-II regression + empty-case, fails: no module) -> create xa_spectra.py (C_CM, _has_M, _dom, _strength_matrix [no-M=branching_ratios; M=sum_p|Calculate_TDMs|^2], line_list, LINE_COLUMNS) -> test passes (T2 OK 4 rows; hits 3) -> commit.

tasks.subject: Task 3: averaged_branching (thesis Eq. 3.4)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the excited-state-averaged BR: average per-excited-sublevel normalized BR over every excited F and M_F with equal weight; sums to 1 over the ground manifold.

**Files:** Modify Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/xa_spectra.py (append averaged_branching) + test_xa_spectra.py (append T3).

**Acceptance:** avg_df['BR'].sum()==1 (1e-9) for BaF A2Pi1/2(J=1/2,+)->X N=1; average == equal-weight mean of per_sublevel columns; sum over X N=0 <= 1e-3 (parity closure).

**Verify:** conda run -n Structure python "Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/test_xa_spectra.py"; echo EXIT=$?

**Steps:** append T3 test (fails: no attribute) -> append averaged_branching(Ground,Excited,e_select,...) returning (avg_df, per_df) -> T3 passes (sum(BR)=1.000000) -> commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/xa_spectra.py", "Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/test_xa_spectra.py"], "verifyCommand": "conda run -n Structure python \"Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/test_xa_spectra.py\"; echo EXIT=$?", "acceptanceCriteria": ["avg_df BR sum == 1 (1e-9)", "avg == equal-weight mean of per_sublevel columns", "sum over X N=0 <= 1e-3 (parity closure preserved)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: broaden + doppler_fwhm + plot_spectrum
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add lineshape convolution (Gaussian/Lorentzian/Voigt, area|peak norm), Doppler-width helper (thesis Eq. 3.15), one-call plot with optional experimental overlay.

**Files:** Modify Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/xa_spectra.py (append 3 fns) + test_xa_spectra.py (append T4).

**Acceptance:** doppler_fwhm matches 2sqrt(2ln2)(nu0/c)sqrt(kT/M) (1e-6 rel); area-norm Gaussian integral ~ summed strength (+-1%); peak-norm single line peaks at its strength; clustering merges co-frequent lines; plot_spectrum returns Axes with stick+broadened+experimental, no exception.

**Verify:** conda run -n Structure python "Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/test_xa_spectra.py"; echo EXIT=$?

**Steps:** confirm scipy.special.voigt_profile present -> append T4 test (fails) -> append doppler_fwhm, _cluster, broaden, plot_spectrum -> T4 passes (doppler=... MHz) -> commit.
